title: README names the export engine 'agents' (engines/agents) while syntopica AGENTS.md uses 'scribe' (engines/scribe)
notes: Found 2026-11-23 installing a fresh instance on a second macOS machine (Darwin 27.2, uv 0.11, pnpm 11) following syntopica AGENTS.md.

README Usage: '(cd engines/agents && pnpm conversations:export ...)'; the hub's init writes engines.scribe and AGENTS.md clones syntopica/scribe. A newcomer following the README hits a missing directory.
done_when: README and AGENTS.md name the same engine and path
